title: Instructions for Form 1120 (2025), U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return

passages.question: What is the 2025 corporate income tax rate?
passages.excerpt: Line 1a. Income tax. Multiply taxable income (page 1, line 30) by 21% (0.21). Enter this amount on line 1a.

passages.question: When is the 2025 calendar-year return due?
passages.excerpt: Generally, a corporation must file its income tax return by the 15th day of the 4th month after the end of its tax year.

passages.question: Must HANGS complete Schedules L, M-1 and M-2, and is Schedule M-3 needed instead?
passages.excerpt: Corporations with total receipts (page 1, line 1a plus lines 4 through 10) and total assets at the end of the tax year less than $250,000 are not required to complete Schedules L, M-1, and M-2 ... Corporations with total assets nonconsolidated ... of $10 million or more on the last day of the tax year must file Schedule M-3 (Form 1120) instead of Schedule M-1.
